structured_plan.G: No integrated candidate yet. After research, retain only candidates that pass all correctness checks, compare their measured performance under the official protocol, and independently confirm the selected result before final integration.
structured_plan.analysis: Choose N=2: the baseline is correct and measures about 52.1 µs (three samples) for 65,536 bytes, leaving two distinct single-core throughput avenues worth testing. One tree explores vectorized validation of UTF-8 structure and scalar boundary/tail handling; the other improves the existing scalar design by skipping ASCII runs in machine-word chunks and validating non-ASCII sequences scalarly. These avoid duplicating the same mechanism. The stated target is EPYC 9654/GCC 14.2, x86_64, one core; compiler ISA flags are not supplied, so SIMD work must use only instructions supported by the actual build. No new performance claims are available at planning time.

children.objective: Explore a full block-oriented SIMD UTF-8 validator for the supplied input, using only ISA features supported by the actual build. Check byte classes, continuation structure, and the special second-byte bounds that reject overlong forms, surrogates, and code points above U+10FFFF. Handle block crossings and the tail without out-of-bounds reads. Preserve exact scalar-value validation for every input, write uint32_t 1 or 0 on every call, and obey the threads budget. Measure against the baseline on the official mixed-width workload; record failed approaches and verify malformed and ASCII cases.
children.subject: Vectorized full UTF-8 structural validation

children.objective: Explore a serial scalar optimization that skips all-ASCII chunks with safe machine-word loads (for example, via memcpy) and validates non-ASCII sequences with a compact, bounds-safe path. Preserve the existing ASCII fast-path intent while ensuring every lead-byte range, continuation, truncation, overlong, surrogate, and maximum-code-point case is handled correctly. Do not rely on alignment beyond the stated guarantee, read past n, cache answers, or specialize to benchmark contents. Respect the threads budget and measure on the official mixed-width workload; record failed approaches and test malformed and ASCII cases.
children.subject: Chunked ASCII skipping with a scalar UTF-8 validator
